instruction: On the Desktop, update the folder called 'data_analysis_old' to 'data_analysis_new'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task variation: Rename folder with old/new suffix pattern (data_analysis_old -> data_analysis_new). Similar difficulty to original - simple folder rename operation on Desktop. Evaluator checks if renamed folder exists using shell command.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies BOTH conditions required for rename operation: (1) new directory 'data_analysis_new' exists AND (2) old directory 'data_analysis_old' no longer exists
Shell command logic is correct: '[ -d ~/Desktop/data_analysis_new ] && [ ! -d ~/Desktop/data_analysis_old ]' uses AND operator to ensure both conditions are true
Expected value 'Rename successful.\n' correctly matches the success output from the command
Evaluator prevents false positives - will fail if user only creates new directory without removing old one
Complete coverage of instruction requirement: verifies the rename operation actually occurred, not just directory creation
